label: About
description: Who we are and how we started.

settings.text: Neighbours feeding neighbours in Larkfield since 2009.

settings.heading: How we started
settings.text:
Larkfield Community Kitchen started in a church hall in 2009 with one soup pot and six volunteers. Today we run a choice pantry, cook a free lunch twice a week and deliver groceries to neighbours who can't get out.

Anyone who lives in Larkfield or the river villages is welcome. There are no forms, and nobody asks why you came.
